summary: TRANSCRIPT API KEY problem: limit-exceeded. 2026-08-10: 26/26 attempted, 16 success. Archon recluster moved Outlaw raid B->C; 2 forecasts. WCL rDPS still broken.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages (raid + M+ x DPS/Healer/Tank) fetched live by urllib with the full browser header set, HTTP 200, 212-371 KB. Parsed <table class="tier-list">: first <td> = tier letter, tier-list-entry img alt = "Spec Class" matched WHOLE against the roster. 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Era-verified per <title>: raid DPS "Midnight (12.0.7)", raid tank "Patch 12.0.7 / Season 1", the other four "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight" — Season 1, no season flip, seasonVerified stays s1 on all 6 pages. Page-own JSON-LD dateModified re-read and unchanged (raid healer 2026-08-04, raid tank 2026-06-30, the other four 2026-07-01), agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) fetched live, HTTP 200, 220-357 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as this source requires: every <title> reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)" — Season 2, correct page. 40/40 specs placed (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank), no TBD anywhere this week so no explicit nulls were needed, 0 tier moves. published re-read from the page itself = 2026-08-02 (unchanged; its Sunday rebuild cadence means a published date trailing snapshot is normal), matching published-evidence 3/3.

Both pages fetched live, HTTP 200 (153 KB raid / 165 KB M+). Parsed the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = letter, tier__entries img alt = "Spec Class"). 79 assignments, 0 unmatched, 0 tier moves. Vengeance DH remains absent from the RAID list upstream (39 raid rows, 40 M+) — a documented Method omission, not a parse miss, so it is omitted rather than invented. The M+ list still has an empty S tier. Era-verified: both pages self-identify Midnight / Season 1, seasonVerified stays s1.

All 6 pages fetched live with the full browser header set, HTTP 200, 73-322 KB (a plain UA alone is Cloudflare-403 on /guide/*). Tiers parsed from the embedded [tier-list=rows] BBCode by splitting on [tier] blocks and reading [tier-label] + [spec-badge=...] — the split matters: an earlier tag-adjacency regex silently dropped Holy Priest's C tier because that block carries an extra newline between label and content. 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, 0 tier moves. Wowhead REMAINS AHEAD on Season 2 (all 6 titles read "Midnight Season 2"), so seasonVerified stays s2, it stays out of the live consensus via the frozen lane, and it stays in the next-patch forecast input. JSON-LD dateModified: M+ healer 2026-08-09, the other five 2026-08-08 — matching published-evidence 6/6.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag in raw HTML (specTierListSection.tierLists[] — metric "throughput" for raid, "score" for M+, never the default popularity grouping). 80 assignments, 0 unmatched. TWO tier moves, both raid, both one band and both at a cluster boundary: Frost DK A->B (175.1k, against an A tier whose lowest member is 177.2k) and Outlaw Rogue B->C. Re-fetched twice to rule out a transport flake — byte-identical both times. Archon's page label lastUpdated is still 2026-08-09T12:00:00Z (its daily 12:00Z rebuild had not run when this nightly started at 11:32Z), so this reads as Archon reclustering its own boundary rather than a Blizzard retune; no anomaly ack proposed. Era: pages self-identify Season 1, seasonVerified stays s1.

Full re-fetch of all 9 Season-1 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, 51/51 HTTP 200, 40/40 specs on every encounter = 680 tier rows (floor 440). 32 per-encounter tier moves, all raid, all one band — the largest clusters on Vaelgor & Ezzorak (12) and Imperator (5). Stored encounter NAMES deliberately kept, because Archon's selector labels are short forms ("Imperator" vs our "Imperator Averzian"); only the tier maps and asOf were rewritten.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages: 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40/40 specs, merged via apply-metrics' survivability key. Read from the metric "survivability" tierList specifically, not the default popularity grouping.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList, which carries letters only) on the raid DPS + raid tank pages = 33 rows, n = each spec's parse count. All 33 values moved vs stored (e.g. Frost Mage 177031 -> 177235, Unholy DK 172607 -> 172787), so the aggregate has genuinely rolled forward since the last fetch and asOf advances to the observation date. Disclosure: Archon's own page label lastUpdated still reads 2026-08-09T12:00:00Z, because its daily 12:00Z rebuild lands after this nightly's 11:32Z start.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection hps column = 7/7 healer specs with n = parses. All 7 values moved (e.g. Resto Shaman 188788 -> 189749, Mistweaver 219456 -> 219945). Emitted as its own row rather than folded into archon-metrics so a failure of one series can never be hidden by the other.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages' specRankingsSection score column = 40/40 specs with n = parses. ZERO numeric changes this run — the score is a slow, weekly-scale number and Archon's M+ aggregate has not re-cut since the last fetch. Popularity on the very same rows did move, which is what confirms the pages are live rather than cached.

80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+) parsed from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100, rounded to 1 decimal to match the stored precision. 74 of 80 values moved. Kept honestly labelled as representation and never converted to a letter.

Fetched via the JSON API only, never the stale S3 HTML prerender: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json + /rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, both plain curl, HTTP 200. Selected categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField == lowerBound AND keyRange undefined (a whitelist, so melee/ranged cannot double-count dps) = 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 40/40 class/spec names byte-identical to the roster. UPSTREAM IS UNCHANGED: manifest.snapshotDate is still 2026-08-05 and all 40 lowerBound values compare byte-identical to what is stored, so nothing was re-merged and the stored asOf is deliberately NOT restamped to today — asOf is the source's snapshotDate, never the run date. 5 days old against a maxAgeDays of 8.

This agent holds NO Warcraft Logs credentials and fetched nothing from warcraftlogs.com by any means. Its only WCL input is wcl-fetch/evidence.json from the deterministic pre-agent step, whose verdict is "rdps-broken": characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 returns a bare "Internal server error" (HTTP 200, 0 rankings) while OAuth and GraphQL transport are both healthy (rate limit 3600/h, 1 point spent). The redistributed-credit metric family is still broken upstream, so "Median rDPS/HPS (Mythic, all bosses)" cannot honestly land and the stored 2026-08-07 cut is left exactly as it was.

Same cause as wcl-live-raid: no credentials held, no warcraftlogs.com fetch attempted, and the pre-agent evidence verdict is "rdps-broken". "Median rDPS/HPS (M+, all dungeons[, tank])" stays frozen at its stored 2026-08-07 values.

Zone-54 "12.1 PTR raid testing score (normalized)" is unreachable for the same reason — no credentials, evidence verdict "rdps-broken", and the normalized cross-boss score has no API analogue even when rdps works. The stored 34 rows stay at 2026-07-28. Context worth keeping in view: this is the series that reaches nobody in the raid projection (all 34 rows carry n of 1..9 against MIN_RANK_N 10), so its staleness does not move a forecast.
Zone-56 "Mythic+ Season 2 (PTR)" rDPS/HPS medians — no credentials held, no fetch attempted, evidence verdict "rdps-broken". The 40 stored rows stay at 2026-08-07.

spec.ptrDummy (zone 52 median rDPS by target count) is an rDPS-family series and stays frozen with the other four cuts under the same "rdps-broken" evidence verdict. 27 specs stay at 2026-08-07. Its raw-DPS counterpart DID land this run — see wcl-dummy-raw — and the two are deliberately kept as different statistics.

Landed by the deterministic pre-agent fetch step itself (frozen recipe, owner-approved 2026-07-17) — this agent neither fetched nor edited these rows. evidence.landed["wcl-dummy-raw"] = 104 rows built and applied across all four DPS dummies with full pagination: 1T 2000 ranked players, 2T 635, 3T 288, 5T 2000. Stored as "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR Dummy Dome, NT)" at 2026-08-10; 106 rows in the family, 104 of them fresh.

Also landed by the deterministic step: evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-raid-raw"] = 27 rows built and applied, pooled over the 6 Venomous Abyss encounters that have parses (Nek'zali 370 players, Entombed Sentinels 363, Vashnik 678, The Lost Explorers 150, Sszorak 184, The Twin Fangs 146; The Coiled Altar and Ula'tek report 0, which is an untested window rather than an error). Stored at 2026-08-10.
Also landed by the deterministic step: evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-mplus-raw"] = 27 rows built and applied, pooled over all 8 Season-2 PTR dungeons at 2000 ranked players each. Stored at 2026-08-10.

All three meta pages (dps/healer/tank M+) fetched by plain GET, HTTP 200, 41-72 KB — never r.jina.ai, which does not work on murlok. Parsed the meta-item anchors (spec from the /class/spec/m+ href, value from the number following the chart svg). 39 of 40 specs landed and 27 values moved. PROTECTION PALADIN IS ABSENT from the tank page upstream this run — it lists only 5 tanks (Guardian, Brewmaster, Blood, Prot Warrior, Vengeance) — so its stored row keeps its previous value and date rather than being deleted or invented. Era-verified: all three titles read "Midnight Season 1".

All 27 DPS specs requested from talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 4 retries each; 26 charts returned with simc_settings.tier == MID1 and all 6 target counts. Augmentation Evoker returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on every retry — the documented genuine absence, not a transient. UPSTREAM HAS NOT RE-SIMMED: every chart's own timestamp is unchanged (25 specs at 2026-07-08, Elemental Shaman alone at 2026-07-15) and all 26 target maps compare byte-identical to what is stored, so nothing was merged and asOf stays the CHART's date rather than being restamped to today. That leaves the sims 33 days old against a maxAgeDays of 5, and the resulting red heartbeat is the correct signal that Bloodmallet has stalled.

MID1_Raid.html fetched live, HTTP 200, 37.2 MB. It is the SAME completed report as the last run — its own "Timestamp: 2026-08-08 07:28:33+0000" and git build 2026-08-06/68974 are unchanged. Verified rather than assumed: the first DPS-ranking chart was bracket-matched out of the report and all 26 stored "SimC nightly Patchwerk DPS" values reproduce exactly (the parse needs a hyphen-tolerant name regex — Havoc's profile is MID1_Demon_Hunter_Havoc_Fel-Scarred). Nothing merged; asOf held at the report's own 2026-08-08.

Fetched DIRECTLY (r.jina.ai still 403s on this host): /period/latest is server-rendered, HTTP 200, 206 KB. STILL PERIOD 1075, week 20 of MID1 (Top 2000 keys, 10000 characters / 3949 unique, 21.8 average key level) — the same weekly bucket as the last run, and all 39 parsed values compare byte-identical to what is stored. Nothing was merged and the stored asOf is deliberately not restamped. Devastation Evoker remains absent from the top-2000 representation chart (its stored row stays at 2026-08-07 with value 0), so 39 of 40 rows carry the current period.

No new build to log — the feed is unchanged at 15 entries, newest the 2026-08-06 launch patch notes. All three channels checked. (1) Official thread 2317811.json: highest_post_number is still 19 (Linxy, 2026-07-31), already logged. (2) Wowhead news RSS (40 items, 2026-08-02..2026-08-09, bodies read from content:encoded): the 12.1 items are Jimothy datamined in the latest PTR build (cosmetic), More Season 2 M+ Dungeon Tuning (Ruby Life Pools / Temple encounter tuning), Datamined Hotfixes (M+/raid/delve ability FLAGS, no spec lines), Embellishment and Potion tuning (items), Altar of Fangs dungeon changes, and the Blizzard/Icy Veins/Raider.IO interview — in which Blizzard says the Season 2 class-tuning ROADMAP ships "in the next couple of days", still a lead rather than tuning data. None carries a per-spec tuning line. (3) Standalone blue posts: a Discourse search for @Kaivax and @Linxy since 2026-08-04 returns only season-end, housing, server and M+ score topics, and the Wowhead blue-tracker RSS (50 items, newest 2026-08-08) carries no class tuning. Confirmed from the same sweep: 12.1 goes LIVE 2026-08-11 and Season 2 starts 2026-08-18, so the owner's two one-shot launch actions (snapshot --frozen, then SNAPSHOT_PHASE) are days away and PHASE_FLIP_DUE is 2026-08-20. Also re-checked writeup material for the 9 specs still at ptr: null (Frost DK, Feral/Guardian/Restoration Druid, Holy Priest, Elemental Shaman, all three Warlocks): no spec-review article for any of them is in the RSS window, and Wowhead's site search is JS-hydrated (its HTML carries zero /news/ hrefs, and the suggestions API returns items and spells only), so they honestly stay null.

TRANSCRIPT BUDGET EXHAUSTED — transcript-fetch/summary.json verdict "limit-exceeded" on the first queued video (_gt1uHQrh1s), 1 requested / 0 fetched, remaining queue untouched. No transcript was readable this run, so ZERO takes and ZERO metaNotes were added or changed; this agent fetched nothing from YouTube or any transcript API. Discovery still ran in full: all 43 transcribable YouTube channels in community.json (40 specialist + 3 general) polled via the RSS feed endpoint, 43/43 HTTP 200, zero failures. Seen-set rebuilt from the four structured lanes (queued + skipped + seen + every youtu.be id in takes/metaNotes) = 742 ids against 645 feed videos; 122 unseen on or after the cycle bound 2026-06-18 and 9 unseen before it. The 9 pre-cycle videos (all Nintern, 2026-03-20..2026-06-15) were appended to seen[], since a video predating the 12.1 cycle cannot discuss it. Two videos queued, keyword-filtered as the nightly must be against the 100-request monthly Supadata budget: Zorthas' "FINAL TIER LIST for Season 2 M+ Midnight" (2026-08-09 — the general-lane metaNote archetype, and his live metaNotes are all 2026-07-30 or older) and Kalamazi's "I'm Back! Sunday PTR Slammin" (2026-08-10 — Warlock, launch eve). The queue now holds 6. Deliberately NOT queued and deliberately NOT written to seen[], so a local yt-dlp run can still sweep them for free: YoDaTV's 8 Season-2 dungeon guides, Supatease's PvP tier list and arena streams (PvP is out of scope for a PvE tracker), and the July backlog of stream VODs whose creators already hold newer live takes. Zorthas' community.json `latest` was refreshed to name the queued video and to say plainly that it is not yet distilled.
